Private Function Named(ByVal wb As Workbook) As String
    Dim n As Name, s As String
    For Each n In wb.Names
        s = s & "|" & n.Name & "=" & n.RefersTo
    Next
    Named = s
End Function

Private Sub Clear(ByVal ws As Worksheet)
    Do While ws.Parent.Names.Count > 0
        ws.Parent.Names(1).Delete
    Loop
End Sub

Public Function Sides(ByVal t As Boolean, ByVal l As Boolean, ByVal b As Boolean, ByVal r As Boolean) As String
    Dim ws As Worksheet, v As Variant
    Set ws = ActiveSheet
    Clear ws
    ws.Cells.Clear
    ws.Range("B1").Value = "TopA"
    ws.Range("C1").Value = "TopB"
    ws.Range("D1").Value = "TopC"
    ws.Range("A2").Value = "LeftA"
    ws.Range("A3").Value = "LeftB"
    ws.Range("A4").Value = "LeftC"
    ws.Range("B5").Value = "BottomA"
    ws.Range("C5").Value = "BottomB"
    ws.Range("D5").Value = "BottomC"
    ws.Range("E2").Value = "RightA"
    ws.Range("E3").Value = "RightB"
    ws.Range("E4").Value = "RightC"
    ws.Range("A1").Value = "CornerTL"
    ws.Range("E1").Value = "CornerTR"
    ws.Range("A5").Value = "CornerBL"
    ws.Range("E5").Value = "CornerBR"
    ws.Range("B2:D4").Value = 7
    On Error GoTo Failed
    v = ws.Range("A1:E5").CreateNames(Top:=t, Left:=l, Bottom:=b, Right:=r)
    Sides = TypeName(v) & " " & CStr(v) & Named(ws.Parent)
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Sides = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Split(Err.Description, vbLf)(0) & Named(ws.Parent)
End Function
